entries.text: Result readers accept schema 2.4: the loader, normalizer, explorer input and bundle validator read the new optional per-query `request_count`, `result_bytes` and `platform_timing`, and the run-level `timing_method`, `platform_timing` and `net_estimate_status`, plus `environment.client_link.probed_at`. Producers still write 2.3; the fields support comparing local and cloud runs with the client round trip removed. A run marked `net_estimate_status: eligible` must use `timing_method` 2 and must not be embedded.
